visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hand holds up a Peppa Pig lantern that flashes with blue and white lights against a blurred domestic background. (2) The camera focuses on a 2025 calendar page for February, highlighting the 12th as the Lantern Festival. (3) A piece of pink satin fabric with gold floral embroidery is spread out on a desk near a computer monitor. (4) A close-up shot shows a sewing machine in operation, with a hand guiding the pink fabric through the needle. (5) Layers of white tulle and delicate floral lace patches are being hand-sewn and assembled into a garment. (6) A finished child-sized Hanfu-style dress with a wide, glowing tulle skirt embedded with LED lights is displayed on a wooden mannequin. (7) A young girl with a floral headpiece wears the dress, smiling and spinning while holding a red paper lantern in a brightly lit living room.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Friendly female narration in Mandarin explains the background context while faint plastic rustling of a lantern is heard. (2) The narrator's pitch rises excitedly as she mentions the Lantern Festival. (3) A sudden, loud, and rhythmic mechanical clicking of a sewing machine dominates the track, paired with the narrator mimicking the sound 'che che che'. (4) The mechanical noise stops, returning to clear narration about the sewing details over a quiet room tone. (5) An upbeat Korean Pop song with a driving electronic beat and bright female vocals fades in, overlapping with the sound of a young child laughing and squealing in delight. (6) The music continues as a catchy bed while the female narrator provides a final enthusiastic call-to-action.
